Given the application configuration, When inspecting the datastore engine, Then PostgreSQL 15 is configured in docker-compose, pom.xml, and properties.
Given the implementation is complete, When the backend verification workflow runs, Then all API and E2E tests including EmployeeDossier tests pass.
